scripts.platform: npm run build -w @mtv/platform && concurrently -n feed,platform -c yellow,green "npm run start -w @mtv/feed" "npm run start -w @mtv/platform"
scripts.platform:dev: concurrently -n feed,platform -c yellow,green "npm run start -w @mtv/feed" "npm run dev -w @mtv/platform"
scripts.build: npm run generate -w @mtv/db && npm run build -w @mtv/platform
